digest.component_or_area: rebar CLI read surfaces (show, list, search, ready) under write-burst contention
propositions: Read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) must not return empty/truncated stdout on exit 0 when reconverge lock contention occurs under concurrent background pushes.

Exit code 0 from any read surface implies stdout must parse as valid JSON matching the surface's documented shape (dict for show; array for list/search/ready), with valid-empty [] distinguishable from truncated-empty.
Throttle marker must be cleared before each parameterized read invocation to ensure every surface exercises the reconverge lock path rather than short-circuiting the local snapshot.
Reverting _RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT from 2 seconds back to 15 seconds causes reads to stall and violate the output-integrity property on write-burst contention.
